					 Animal Rescue / Animal Control 
Learn about animal rescue and animal control. 
					 Assessing 
The purpose of the Assessing department is to develop, through an annual appraisal process, equitable assessments for all properties within the Town. This assures that each taxpayer pays only his or her fair share of the annual tax levy of the Town. 
					 Building, Health & Code Enforcement 
The Building, Health, and Code Enforcement Department’s mission and goals relate to the timely provision of public services to the public and the Town government, in areas dealing with permits, inspections, code compliance, and citizen’s inquiries.

					 Human Services 
The Hampstead contracts out the administration of the Town’s general assistance program to Community Health Services located in Derry, NH. CHS serves as a resource for all residents seeking assistance with the essential provisions of life. 
					 Library 
Hampstead Public Library offers some valuable learning resources through several channels. 
					 Police Department 
Welcome to the Hampstead Police Department web page. We serve a community of approximately 9000 residents. We are a progressive full-time police department that is committed to building trust through transparency. 
					 Public Works Department 
The Highway Division is responsible for maintaining approximately 70 miles of roadway, including but not limited to snow removal, de-icing, drainage repair and maintenance, road reconstruction, line painting, pothole patching, street sweeping, and installing street signs. 
					 Recreation 
The Town of Hampstead Recreation Department is dedicated to providing quality recreation facilities, programs, and services to enhance the quality of life for the residents of Hampstead. 
					 Recycling & Waste Disposal 
Stay in-the-know with any late announcements regarding pick-up changes as well as great tips on how to reduce your trash by recycling items you may not have known were recycling and by composting. 
					 School District

					 Town Clerk / Tax Collector 
The mission for the Town Clerk and Tax Collector is to accurately and efficiently make collections and timely deposits of Town monies, to preserve all Vital Records and Recordings of the Town; to courteously and efficiently service the residents of the Town of Hampstead. 
					 Town Moderator 
It is the duty of the Town Moderator to ensure that the election process is fair and is conducted in accordance with State laws.
